definitions: A colourless, flammable gaseous hydrocarbon, C2H4, that is the simplest alkene, used in the production of polyethylene and other organic compounds, and as a ripening agent for fruit.
The univalent radical −CH2CH2 derived from ethylene.
examples: Ethylene is a key component in the plastics industry.
The fruit was ripened using ethylene gas.
The chemical formula for ethylene is C2H4.
